title: HIGH dangerous-recommendation in red-team repo → §5.4 must NOT demote (severity gate ≤ medium)
description: D3 boundary case. The §5.4 correlator only demotes dangerous-recommendation findings at severity ≤ medium. A HIGH dangerous-recommendation in red-team context should remain alarming — even an educational frame doesn't excuse advice that crosses the high-severity bar. Verifies the severity gate.

m2_expected.rationale: Per §5.4 + D3: educational/red-team context demotes ONLY findings at severity ≤ medium. A HIGH advice finding stays as-is — the educational frame doesn't override sufficiently dangerous recommendations. Verifies the severity gate prevents under-reporting of seriously bad advice.
